name: nixhm-sudo-oci-mail
description: Home Manager system image for oci-mail (Stalwart, SnappyMail, Maddy, Dagu)

public_ports.desc: SMTP (Maddy MX — must be public, RFC)
SMTP proxy (CF Worker ingress — Cloudflare has no WireGuard)

_obsolete_systemd_units_note: Stranded systemd units left over from migrations (e.g., a service that became a docker container). The protection/obsolete-cleanup.nix module reads this array and on every home-manager activation: stops, disables, masks, and removes /etc/systemd/system/<unit>. List is intentionally per-VM — the same unit name on a different VM may still be in use.

obsolete_systemd_units._why: Replaced by docker container at /opt/containers/smtp-proxy (Rust). Old Python /opt/smtp-proxy/smtp_proxy.py was deleted during migration but the systemd unit at /etc/systemd/system/smtp-proxy.service was left behind, restarting every 5s (NRestarts=60636+ as of 2026-05-07). RestartSec=5 in the leftover unit means ~17280 fail-restart events per day.
